info.title: Product Parameters
info.description:
**This API specification is a draft and is not yet implemented. Endpoints, schemas, and
behavior are subject to change without notice.**

This API provides services to read and maintain the parameters that apply to public transport
products — for example when a product can be purchased (purchase window).

tags.name: Purchase window
tags.description:
A purchase window defines when a product can be purchased relative
to the time of travel — for example up to 90 days before and at least one hour before
departure, or only until the day before travel. Products reference it through
`purchaseWindowRef`.

get.summary: List purchase windows with their current versions
get.description:
Returns a paginated list of purchase windows, ordered by id. Each entry is a light summary
(`VersionedElementSummary`, shared with other element types) with the purchase window id
and the versions that are relevant today:

- VERSIONED versions valid today or in the future (no end date, or an end date after today)
- DRAFT and PROPOSED versions, regardless of date
- with `includeDeprecated=true`, also the most recent DEPRECATED version (latest start date)

Versions are ordered by status (DRAFT, PROPOSED, VERSIONED, DEPRECATED) and then by start date,
newest first. Purchase windows without any such version are left out. Paging is per purchase
window, so the versions of one purchase window are never split across pages.

All versions of a single purchase window are available through
`GET /v3/parameters/purchase-windows/{id}/versions`, and the full content of a version through
`GET /v3/parameters/purchase-windows/{id}/{version}`.

parameters.name: includeDeprecated
parameters.description: Also include the most recent DEPRECATED version of each purchase window.

parameters.name: ownerOrganisationId
parameters.description: Only return purchase windows owned by this internal organisation id.

200.description: Paginated list of purchase window summaries

post.description: Create a new purchase window. A new version is created together with it.

400.description:
The request is invalid — either a schema violation, or a well-formed request that
cannot be processed, such as an invalid ISO 8601 duration or a
`maximumPeriodBeforeDeparture` shorter than `minimumPeriodBeforeDeparture`.

value.title: Bad Request
value.detail: maximumPeriodBeforeDeparture (PT1H) must not be shorter than minimumPeriodBeforeDeparture (P1D).

get.summary: Get the active version of a purchase window
get.description:
Retrieve the version of the purchase window that is active on the given date.
Defaults to the version active today when no date is given.

200.description: The purchase window version active on the given date.

404.description: Purchase window not found, or no version is active on the given date

post.summary: Create a new version of an existing purchase window
post.description:
Create a new version of an existing purchase window. Products referencing the
purchase window are not modified: they point at its id, and the effective version
is resolved by validity period.

get.summary: List versions of a purchase window
get.description:
Retrieve all versions of a purchase window by its NeTEx ID, including drafts and
proposals.

get.summary: Get a specific purchase window version
get.description:
Retrieve a specific version of a purchase window, identified by NeTEx version id or
version number.

404.description: Purchase window or version not found

put.summary: Update an existing purchase window version
put.description: Update a purchase window version in place. Only DRAFT versions can be updated.

requestBody.description: The updated purchase window version. The existing data in the version is replaced by this one.

404.description: Purchase window or version not found

409.description: The version is not a DRAFT and cannot be updated

value.title: Conflict
value.detail: PurchaseWindow 'ENT:PurchaseWindow:90days' cannot be modified because version 'ENT:Version:8f1b2c3d' has status VERSIONED; only DRAFT versions may be modified. Create a new version to update.

delete.description: Delete a purchase window version. Only DRAFT versions can be deleted.

404.description: Purchase window or version not found

409.description: The version is not a DRAFT and cannot be deleted

value.title: Conflict
value.detail: PurchaseWindow 'ENT:PurchaseWindow:90days' cannot be deleted because version 'ENT:Version:8f1b2c3d' has status VERSIONED; only DRAFT versions may be deleted.

get.description: Retrieve a specific version by its netex ID.

put.description: Update an existing version. Can be used to change status (e.g., from DRAFT to PROPOSED or PROPOSED to VERSIONED) or modify dates.

requestBody.description:
The request body must include the new status and startDate. The endDate is optional. Valid status transitions are:
  - DRAFT -> PROPOSED
  - PROPOSED -> VERSIONED
  - DRAFT -> DEPRECATED
  - PROPOSED -> DEPRECATED

400.description: Bad request - Invalid data or illegal status transition

409.description: Conflict - Version already exists or overlaps with existing version

post.description: Create a new version in DRAFT status. The version will be assigned the current date as startDate if not provided.

requestBody.description: The request body must include the netex ID and status (must be DRAFT). The startDate is optional and will default to the current date if not provided. The endDate is also optional.

value.title: Illegal status for new version
value.detail: Invalid version status VERSIONED. New versions must be created with status DRAFT.

value.title: Illegal date for new version
value.detail: Invalid version dates: endDate must be strictly after startDate.

value.title: Conflict with other in progress
value.detail: Cannot create new version: ENT:Version:001 are already in PROPOSED (only one in-progress version allowed).

VersionSummary.description:
A light summary of one version of a versioned element, as shown in lists. Shared by the list
endpoints of all element types.

ownerOrganisationId.description: Internal organisation id owning the element.

VersionedElementSummary.description:
A versioned element with the versions relevant today, as shown in lists. Shared by the list
endpoints of all element types. The versions are:

- VERSIONED versions valid today or in the future (no end date, or an end date after today)
- DRAFT and PROPOSED versions, regardless of date
- when deprecated versions are requested, the most recent DEPRECATED version (latest start date)

ordered by status (DRAFT, PROPOSED, VERSIONED, DEPRECATED) and then by start date, newest first.

PurchaseWhen.description:
When a purchase can be made relative to the time of travel.

- **ADVANCE_ONLY** - Only in advance of the day of travel.
- **UNTIL_PREVIOUS_DAY** - Until the end of the day before travel.
- **DAY_OF_TRAVEL_ONLY** - Only on the day of travel.
- **ADVANCE_AND_DAY_OF_TRAVEL** - In advance or on the day of travel.
- **TIME_OF_TRAVEL_ONLY** - Only at the time of travel.
- **SUBSCRIPTION_CHARGE_MOMENT** - At the charge moment of a subscription.
- **OTHER** - Other rule.

PurchaseAction.description: The type of purchase action the window applies to.

PurchaseMoment.description: A moment at which a purchase can be made.

ownerOrganisationId.description: Internal id of the organisation that owns this element. Omit it to use the organisation in the access token, which is what a caller acting for itself should do. Supplying a different organisation requires permission to act on behalf of that organisation.

startDate.description: First day this purchase window version is valid.

endDate.description: Last day this purchase window version is valid (optional). Omit for an open-ended version.

allOf.description:
Status of the purchase window version. Required; on create only DRAFT or
PROPOSED is accepted — a new version cannot be published directly.

When a purchase can be made relative to the time of travel. Optional: when omitted, the
purchase window sets no restriction on when the purchase can be made, only the periods
before departure (if set) apply.

latestTime.description: Latest time of day a purchase can be made (NeTEx `LatestTime`), formatted `HH:mm:ss`.

minimumPeriodBeforeDeparture.description:
Minimum period before departure that a purchase must be made (NeTEx
`MinimumPeriodBeforeDeparture`). ISO 8601 duration with days, hours, minutes and/or seconds.

maximumPeriodBeforeDeparture.description:
Maximum period before departure that a purchase can be made (NeTEx
`MaximumPeriodBeforeDeparture`). ISO 8601 duration with days, hours, minutes and/or seconds.
Must not be shorter than `minimumPeriodBeforeDeparture`.

allOf.description: The purchase action this window applies to (NeTEx `PurchaseAction`).

purchaseMoments.description: The moments at which a purchase can be made (NeTEx `PurchaseMoment`, a list).

versionNumber.description: Sequence number of this version, when assigned.

ownerOrganisationId.description: Internal organisation id owning this purchase window.

endDate.description: Last day this purchase window version is valid (optional).

When a purchase can be made relative to the time of travel. Absent when the purchase

ET-Client-Name.name: ET-Client-Name
ET-Client-Name.description:
Entur Client Header.
It is required that all consumers identify themselves by using this header.
Entur will deploy strict rate-limiting policies on API-consumers who do not identify with a header and reserves the right to block unidentified consumers.
The structure of ET-Client-Name should be: `<company>-<application>`.
